EffectDescription.Key_mf_chorus_echo: Deal {Number} damage; if you have 3+ cards in hand, deal 4 more.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_swarm_pull: Draw {Number} card(s); if your discard pile has 5+ cards, draw 1 more.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_chain_finish: Deal {Number} damage plus a third of your discard pile (up to 10).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_shield_bash: Deal half your Block as damage (or {Number} if you have none), then lose all Block.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bulwark_pray: Heal for a third of your Block (at least {Number}).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_last_bastion: Gain {Number} Block. At half health or below, gain 10 more Block.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_molt_shell: Lose all Block and draw {Number} card(s).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_feast: Draw {Number} card(s), discard 1 at random, gain 1 Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_glut: Discard {Number} random card(s); gain 1 Black mana for each.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_renew: Heal {Number}. If you have 2 or fewer cards, draw 2 instead.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_void_tithe: Lose {Number} health, gain 8 Block and 2 Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_king_decree: Deal {Number} damage (+1 per 2 cards in hand) and apply 4 Bleed to the opponent.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_grave_swell: Deal damage equal to {Number}x the size of your discard pile.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bellow: Gain {Number} temporary Power; if resolved by Milk Frog, gain {Number1} Power.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bleed_if_cascade: If resolved by Milk Frog, apply {Number} Bleed to the target.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_glare: Apply {Number} Vulnerable to all enemies; if resolved by Milk Frog, deal {Number1} damage to all enemies.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_mother_law: Milk Frog no longer picks automatically — you choose which Milk Frog cards resolve.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_mother_law_full: Milk Frog no longer picks automatically — you choose any cards to resolve.
